name: Scattering Lab
description: The virtual scattering lab: measures the random-incidence scattering coefficient of a sample in the octave bands. The geometric method runs when its inputs change (seconds); kirchhoff and bem take minutes to hours and start only when Run is pressed.

inputParameters.name: method
inputParameters.description: 'geometric' (seconds), 'kirchhoff' or 'bem' (minutes to hours; they start with Run).

inputParameters.name: preset
inputParameters.description: The source directions the sample is measured from: 'survey' (13, default) or 'standard' (97). survey is the quickest, a first look; its random-incidence s can be up to 0.29 off near the onset of grating lobes, so use standard for the values a room model takes. Polar Preview shows the polar response of every direction measured.

inputParameters.name: n_rays
inputParameters.description: Optional. Geometric method only: the number of rays.

inputParameters.name: max_bounces
inputParameters.description: Optional. Geometric method only: the reflections a ray may make between the relief's parts before it counts as lost (default 20). Raise it when the Lab warns about lost rays.

inputParameters.name: cache_dir
inputParameters.description: Optional. The bem method only: NumCalc's project folder, so that an interrupted run resumes.

inputParameters.name: run
inputParameters.description: Press to run. The geometric method runs when the inputs change; kirchhoff and bem take minutes to hours and run only when this is true; a button is added when it is not connected. Press again to run again with the same inputs.

outputParameters.name: scattering
outputParameters.description: Scattering coefficient of the 7 material octave bands, 125 to 8000 Hz (an octave that was not simulated is filled from the nearest one). Pairs with the scattering of Construct Material, not with diffusion.

outputParameters.name: diffusion
outputParameters.description: Normalised diffusion coefficient d_n = (d - d_ref) / (1 - d_ref) (ISO 17497-2) of each simulated octave band, which can be negative; empty when the result has none. It pairs with 'octaves' (6 bands with the ISO range), not with 'scattering'.

outputParameters.name: octaves
outputParameters.description: The simulated octave bands, in Hz; one value of 'diffusion' for each.
